subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected PR be closed as superseded by the merged macOS onboarding work, or should the author rebase only a narrow remaining UX slice onto current main?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label blocks automated cleanup, and current main already moved the macOS onboarding product direction while this branch still has security and upgrade blockers.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR after a maintainer confirms the merged local Gateway bootstrap and Crestodian onboarding cover the desired direction and no unique remaining slice is worth rebasing.

options.title: Request Narrow Rebase
options.body: Ask for a fresh branch containing only the still-desired UI copy or control improvements, with the security/auth fixes and real macOS proof included.

options.title: Adopt Manually
options.body: A maintainer can cherry-pick selected ideas, but should avoid carrying over the credentialed probe, acknowledgement bypass, and env/launchd auth regression.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after a maintainer confirms the merged local Gateway bootstrap and Crestodian onboarding cover the desired direction and no unique remaining slice is worth rebasing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged replacement onboarding direction and is the best available owner for deciding whether this older branch still has a product slice to preserve.
